description: Neighbour enrichment figure and the identity of genomes supporting AmpD and PilZ adjacency
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, json
R=pd.read_csv("neighbour_enrichment.csv")
R=R.sort_values("genomes_within_2")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5))
y=np.arange(len(R))
ax.barh(y-0.19,R.genomes_within_2,height=.38,color="#4C78A8",label="within ±2 genes of DUF1631")
ax.barh(y+0.19,R.genomes_4to10_away,height=.38,color="#BBBBBB",label="4-10 genes away (internal control)")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([p if len(p)<52 else p[:49]+"..." for p in R["product"]],fontsize=8)
for i,(k,q) in enumerate(zip(R.genomes_within_2,R["q"])):
    ax.text(k+0.3,i-0.19,f"q={q:.3f}",va="center",fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel("number of genomes (of 63) with this gene in the window")
ax.set_title("Recurrent gene neighbours of DUF1631 genes across 63 beta/gammaproteobacterial genomes",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right"); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

nb=json.load(open("nb.json"))
print("Genomes where AmpD is within ±2 genes:")
for acc,v in nb.items():
    F=v["feats"]; c=(v["start"]+v["stop"])/2
    idx=int(np.argmin([abs((f["s"]+f["e"])/2-c) for f in F]))
    for j in range(max(0,idx-2),min(len(F),idx+3)):
        if j!=idx and "AmpD" in F[j]["product"]:
            print(f"   {v['org']}"); break
print("\nGenomes where a PilZ-domain gene is within ±2 genes:")
for acc,v in nb.items():
    F=v["feats"]; c=(v["start"]+v["stop"])/2
    idx=int(np.argmin([abs((f["s"]+f["e"])/2-c) for f in F]))
    for j in range(max(0,idx-2),min(len(F),idx+3)):
        if j!=idx and "PilZ" in F[j]["product"]:
            print(f"   {v['org']}  (d={j-idx})"); break
